summary: Typeform qualified 1on1 answer signal to Meta CAPI
description: Accepts a privacy-safe browser signal when one of the five primary Beforest Typeforms reaches its existing qualified 1on1 destination question. Completed responses provide an idempotent fallback. Atomic claims use the managed main data table; this worker never runs Pipedrive or final-submit side effects.

body.description: Browser embed signal or completed Typeform webhook payload.

dry_run.description: Evaluate and preview without reading credentials, state, or Meta.

request_origin.description: HTTPS Origin header supplied by the HTTP preprocessor for browser signals.

use_test_event.description: Use the encrypted Meta Test Events code for delivery verification.
